title: Revision-1-bound provider-neutral capability broker and worktree enforcement

binding.worktree_binding: exclusive supplied observation; immutable for the trace
binding.grant_binding: revision 1 grant and exact allowed tool versions
binding.action_rule: Every action must repeat the exact admission identity and use one granted tool.

capabilities.rule: Unknown, denied, or ungranted tools are rejected before an action is accepted.

enforcement.replay: action IDs and action identity tuples are single-use
enforcement.cross_worktree: the exact worktree key, revision, and digest must match admission
enforcement.cross_project: the exact project key and revision must match admission
enforcement.private_input: private keys and values are prohibited from public evidence

lifecycle.rule: Only granted read/edit/test actions are accepted while active; close is terminal.

privacy.projection: Identifiers, revisions, digests, tool metadata, counts, and dispositions only.

limitations: The model validates supplied observations and does not inspect, create, or isolate a filesystem worktree.
An exclusive worktree binding is an input observation, not proof of filesystem isolation or tool behavior.
The checker performs no provider, network, process, LLM, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or durable-state operation.
